question: If c and d are two integers and @ is defined in p an q as @ (p, q)=(p+1)(q+2), and @ (c, d) equals the product of 2 and 5, then what should be the value of c+d?

question: Two trains are moving in opposite directions at 60 km/hr and 90 km/hr. Their lengths are 1.10 km and 0.9 km respectively. The time taken by the slower train to cross the faster train in seconds is ----
explanation:
🔖আপেক্ষিক বেগ = (60 + 90) km/hr
= \( \left(150\times \frac{5}{18}\right) \) m/s
= \( \frac{125}{3} \) m/s
দূরত্ব অতিক্রম করতে হবে (1.10 + 0.9)km
= 2km
= 2000m
\( \therefore \) নির্ণেয় সময় = \( \frac{2000m}{{\displaystyle \frac{125}{3}m/s}} \) = 48s
